title: TimeBank Business Hours, Observed Holidays and Band Multipliers by Block Size
content:
TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours counts work against fixed business hours, US Eastern time, and each block size sets the multipliers at which work outside them is drawn.

| Figure | 10-Hour | 20-Hour | 40-Hour | 80-Hour | 160-Hour | 320-Hour |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Days of the week counting as business hours | Mon-Fri | Mon-Fri | Mon-Fri | Mon-Fri | Mon-Fri | Mon-Fri |
| Business hours start (US Eastern) | 08:00 | 08:00 | 08:00 | 08:00 | 07:00 | 07:00 |
| Business hours end (US Eastern) | 18:00 | 18:00 | 18:00 | 18:00 | 19:00 | 19:00 |
| Block hours drawn per worked hour outside business hours on a business day (after-hours multiplier) | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.5 | 1.25 | 1.25 |
| Block hours drawn per worked hour on emergency work dispatched outside business hours at the client's request (emergency multiplier) | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 1.75 | 1.5 |
| Block hours drawn per worked hour on weekends and observed holidays (holiday multiplier) | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 1.75 | 1.5 |

## Observed holidays

Every block size observes the same six holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day.

## Points of judgement

- The 160-Hour and 320-Hour Blocks have a longer business day, 07:00 to 19:00, than the smaller sizes, 08:00 to 18:00.
- In business hours the multiplier is 1.
- Hypothetical illustration: one worked hour drawn at the after-hours multiplier is 1.5 block hours on a TimeBank 40-Hour Block and 1.25 block hours on a TimeBank 160-Hour Block.
